status: PRE-REGISTERED. Everything in pre_registration below, including every verdict rule and the exercise gate, is committed to git before any scored arm runs on the GPU. The results block is empty at commit time and is the only block that will change.
purpose: Test-or-retire for LMCache: the one real user corruption report (cosmicnag, context edition discussion #1) has LMCache 0.5.2 kv_both disk reuse at chunk 1600 as its sole surviving suspect after receipts/apc-poison-repro.json (266 scored requests, NOT REPRODUCED without LMCache) and receipts/second-5090-datapoint.json (prefix caching + align clean at the native window on a second physical 5090, LMCache disabled) eliminated every other member of his decisive control. This experiment puts LMCache back in the loop, alone, through the image's own wrapper, and drives the identical frozen poisoning probe through the one path vLLM's own prefix cache can never exercise: reuse after process restart from a warm disk L2.

arms.L0: control: promoted image, reporter profile, glm52-lmcache-wrapper.sh with LMCACHE_MODE=off (the wrapper execs the model server untouched). Fresh server, 38 requests.
arms.L1cold: LMCache kv_both disk, EMPTY L2 (directory wiped, recorded): fresh server, 38 requests. Cold pass: every chunk is stored, nothing can be retrieved from a prior life.
arms.L2warm: the SAME live server immediately after L1cold, 38 requests again. Warm pass: vLLM's own prefix cache and LMCache L1/L2 are all live; whichever layer serves the hit is recorded from the counters, not assumed.
arms.L3restart: full server stop, then a NEW server over the RETAINED L2 directory, 38 requests. Restart pass: vLLM's own prefix cache and LMCache's L1 start empty by construction, so any prefix reuse is LMCache disk retrieval. This is the reuse-after-restart path the reporter's workflow exercised and vLLM's own cache never can, and it is the prime suspect mechanism.
arms.environment_per_arm: LMCACHE_MODE=disk LMCACHE_CHUNK_SIZE=1600 LMCACHE_L1_GB=12 LMCACHE_L1_INIT_GB=2 LMCACHE_L2_GB=32 LMCACHE_L2_WORKERS=4 for the three LMCache arms; eviction LRU 0.90/0.10, prefetch retain, use_odirect false, fs_native, mq_timeout 60, heartbeat 5 are the wrapper's own constants and match the reporter's dump field for field; separate_object_groups is whatever the pinned lmcache server binary defaults to, captured verbatim at stage time
arms.one_variable_at_a_time: L0 -> L1cold changes exactly LMCACHE_MODE; L1cold -> L2warm changes only cache warmth; L2warm -> L3restart changes only process identity over the same disk state

pre_registration.exercise_gate: the experiment is EXERCISED only if the L3restart pass shows nonzero LMCache retrieval activity: nonzero retrieve/hit counters in the lmcache prometheus deltas between the L3restart-pre and L3restart-post snapshots, or explicit successful retrieve lines in the LMCache MP log for that pass, together with a nonempty L2 directory at pass start (file count and bytes recorded). If the gate fails, the verdict is NOT_EXERCISED regardless of how clean the responses are, because a probe that never touched the suspect path proves nothing about it.

verdict_rules.corruption_reproduced: at least one failing request in any of L1cold / L2warm / L3restart AND zero failing requests in L0. Reported immediately to Main as P0 with the failing arm's server log, LMCache MP log and per-request rows. The failing arm's name travels with every statement of the verdict.
verdict_rules.reproduced_without_lmcache_attribution: L0 also has at least one failing request: the profile itself is implicated and LMCache cannot be attributed; escalated identically but named as such.
verdict_rules.bounded_clean: zero failing requests in all four arms AND the exercise gate passes: LMCache kv_both disk reuse at chunk 1600 did not corrupt this workload on this card, stated with per-pass request counts, hit rates and retrieval counters. This bounds the suspect, it does not acquit it: one workload, one card, single-turn text.
verdict_rules.not_exercised: the exercise gate fails, or the LMCache stack refuses to start after the pre-registered fallback ladder: published as the measured obstruction, never as a clean result.
verdict_rules.fallback_ladder: if the server OOMs at startup with LMCache live, raise --gpu-memory-utilization by 0.001 at a time to at most 0.925 (the card's own OOM guidance), recording every step as a deviation; if vLLM rejects the kv-transfer-config for this hybrid model, record the rejection verbatim and stop - that is a NOT_EXERCISED result with the error as the finding
